newsitem.title: USA: Image Systems FY97 sales hurt in 2 markets.
newsitem.headline: Image Systems FY97 sales hurt in 2 markets.

text.p: Image Systems Corp, a maker of high resolution monitors, said Friday that sales for the fiscal year ended April 30 were disappointing in the air traffic control and medical imaging markets.
Sales in the air traffic control market did not meet expectations, while the sales cycle in the medical imaging market was longer than expected, the company said.

"In addition to the modest increase in sales, expenses were higher, largely as a result of our move in February to our new building in Minnetonka, Minnesota," Chief Executive Dean Scheff said. "We are, however, already seeing a dramatic increase in sales early in the first quarter of fiscal 1998 and expect these trends to continue."
Earlier Friday, the company reported sales of $8.1 million for fiscal 1997, down from $7.9 million a year ago.
Net income for the year was $826,590, or $0.19 a share, down from $909,812, or $0.21 a share a year ago.
